title: End-weight và đóng gói thông tin
learningObjectiveVi: Sắp xếp cấu trúc để thành phần dài, mới hoặc phức tạp nằm cuối câu, giúp câu dễ xử lý mà không đổi nghĩa.
learningObjectiveEn: Arrange clauses so long, new, or complex constituents occur late, improving processing without changing meaning.

morphologyNotes: Extraposition must retain the semantic role of the delayed clause and avoid an ambiguous anticipatory pronoun.

uses: Move from given information to new complex information.

usageConstraints: The structure must be motivated by meaning, information flow, stance, or register rather than complexity alone.

rules.description: Extraposition must retain the semantic role of the delayed clause and avoid an ambiguous anticipatory pronoun.
